summary: High-performance JSON Logic rule evaluation for cables.gl website using precompiled engine.build() from imported module JsonLogicEngine

ports.name: Evaluate
ports.text: Triggers immediate evaluation of the precompiled rule against the input facts

ports.name: Input Facts
ports.text: Facts or context object against which the rule is evaluated (e.g. MIDI note data, keyboard events, gamepad)

ports.name: Rule JSON
ports.text: JSON Logic rule object or JSON string. Compiles automatically once on change.

ports.name: Matched
ports.text: Triggers when the evaluated rule result is truthy

ports.name: Result Payload
ports.text: Output value or payload produced by the evaluated rule

ports.name: Not Matched
ports.text: Triggers when the evaluated rule result is falsy

ports.name: Is Matched
ports.text: Boolean flag indicating whether the rule matched (true) or not (false)

changelog.message: op updated to rely on cables imported module JsonLogicEngine
changelog.author: Cables Studio
